notice.title: Details of Registration-cum-Choice Filling for Post Graduate Degree for Post Graduate Degree [PGMAC (Ayush)]-2026 for MD (Unani) on the basis of AIAPGET[AYUSH]-2026 (Adv. No. BCECEB(PGMAC[AYUSH])-2026/05 Dated 05.11.2026)

clauses.text: Eligibility criteria, instructions and other details are available in the Prospectus of PGMAC(Ayush)-2026 for MD (Unani) which can be downloaded from the Board's website bceceboard.bihar.gov.in by clicking on the link “PGMAC(Unanipathy)-2026” under Prospectus Section

* For Eligibility Criteria and other details, required Documents for admission on (DQ) Quota, candidates are advised to see 'Annexure-I' of Information Bulletin of AACCC which can be seen on AACCC Official Website
